{{main article|2000 WTA Tour}}

The [[WTA Tier I events]] are part of the elite tour for professional women's [[tennis]] organised by the [[Women's Tennis Association|WTA]] called the [[WTA Tour]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=2000 Tournaments {{!}} WTA Official |url=https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2000 |url-status=live |archive-url=https://archive.today/20220920184059/https://www.wtatennis.com/tournaments/2000|archive-date=2022-09-20 |website=Women's Tennis Association |language=en}}</ref>

{{Toc limit|3}}
